chapters.name: From the Arabic
chapters.subtitle: Meditations on the soul, love, and detachment

verses.text: O Son of Spirit! My first counsel is this: Possess a pure, kindly and radiant heart, that thine may be a sovereignty ancient, imperishable and everlasting.
verses.original: يا ابن الروح! في أوّل القول أملك قلباً جيّداً حسناً منيراً لتملك ملكاً دائماً باقياً أزلاً قديماً.
verses.transliteration: Yā Ibna'r-Rūḥ! Fī awwali'l-qawli'mlik qalban jayyidan...

verses.text: O Son of Spirit! The best beloved of all things in My sight is Justice; turn not away therefrom if thou desirest Me, and neglect it not that I may confide in thee.
verses.original: يا ابن الروح! أحبّ الأشياء عندي الإنصاف لا ترغب عنه إن تكن إليّ راغباً.

verses.text: O Son of Man! Breathe not the sins of others so long as thou art thyself a sinner. Shouldst thou transgress this command, accursed wouldst thou be, and to this I bear witness.
verses.original: يا ابن الإنسان! لا تنفس خطيئة أحد ما دمت خاطئاً.
verses.transliteration: Yā Ibna'l-Insān! Lā tanaffas khaṭī'ata aḥadin...

chapters.name: From the Persian
chapters.subtitle: On humility, service to humanity, and inner illumination

verses.text: O Son of Being! How couldst thou forget thine own faults and busy thyself with the faults of others? Whoso doeth this is accursed of Me.
verses.original: ای پسر وجود! چگونه خطای خود را فراموش کردی و بخطای دیگران پرداختی؟

verses.text: O Friend! In the garden of thy heart plant naught but the rose of love, and from the nightingale of affection and desire loosen not thy hold.
verses.original: ای دوست! در روضه دل جز گل عشق مکار و از ذیل بلبل حبّ و شوق دست مدار.
